HTML <fetch> responses are cached per app only for anonymous requests without custom headers, cookies or Authorization. Private/no-store, Set-Cookie and Vary responses are not cached. Async fetch uses an encrypted descriptor generated by the renderer, bound to the app, current session/permissions and a 10-minute expiry; do not construct /_internal/fetch URLs manually. Rejected old or expired descriptors trigger an automatic page refresh for HTMX requests, obtaining fresh markup after upgrades or permission changes. Secrets stay inside the encrypted descriptor. Relative URLs require a configured canonical origin; SSRF checks run at render and delivery, and cross-origin redirects are refused.
